privacy.title: Your habits are yours.
privacy.body: Everything you log stays on your iPhone: no account, no cloud, no tracking.
privacy.purchases: Pro purchases go through Apple and are checked with RevenueCat, using a random anonymous ID.

items.q: How do I log a habit?
items.a: Tap any habit card on the Dashboard. A short sheet opens: type your value (7.5 hours of sleep, 2.5 L of water) and tap Save. The entry is recorded at once and your heatmap updates.
Only on your iPhone, in iOS on-device storage. There are no servers, no cloud sync and no accounts. The privacy policy has the full details.

items.q: Can I import my history from a spreadsheet?
items.a: Yes, with Pro. Go to Settings, Data Management, Import Data, and pick a CSV file with the columns date, habit, unit, value and note. The tutorial has a template.

items.q: How do I back up or move my data?
items.a: With Pro, Settings, Data Management, Export Backup saves every habit and log in one CSV file. Import it on the new device with Import Data.

items.q: How do I delete all my data?
items.a: Go to Settings, Data Management, Clear All Data. You will be asked to confirm. This is permanent: it wipes every habit, log and preference from your device.
Pro comes as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase. Prices depend on your country; the App Store shows the current one before you buy.

items.q: Will there be an Android version?
items.a: Not for now. We would rather build one platform well than two poorly.

tutorial.title: Import your data
tutorial.intro: Already tracking habits? Bring your history in, in minutes. Import and backup are part of Pro.

importLogs.title: Import daily logs
importLogs.intro: Import past data for your habits from a CSV file. Each row is one day's entry for one habit.

columns.desc: Must match an existing habit name in the app (case does not matter).
The habit's unit, for your reference. Examples: hours, minutes, km
Optional free text. Leave it blank or leave the column out.

tips: Excel, Google Sheets and Numbers all work: export as .csv or .txt.
Habit names must match: 'Workout' and 'workout' both work, 'Work out' does not match 'Workout'.
If a date and habit already exist, the import updates the value instead of adding a second one.
You can mix several habits in one file.

backup.title: Back up and restore
backup.intro: Export all your habits and logs as one CSV file, to restore on a new device or keep an offline copy.
restoreSteps: Choose Merge with existing or Replace all data
Check the summary and tap Import
backup.autoDetect: The app tells a backup (it has a #HABITS section) from a plain log file by itself. One import button handles both.

reminders.title: Daily reminders
reminders.intro: MyGrowth can send you two notifications a day:
items: a summary of today's scheduled habits. Default: 9:00.
a gentle reminder to log what you missed. Default: 21:00.
reminders.footer: Both can be changed in Settings, Notifications.

pace.title: Pace and speed
pace.intro: For habits like Running and Biking, turn on time tracking in the habit to log distance and time. The app works out:
items: pace in min/km. 7 km in 38 min is 5:25 min/km.
speed in km/h. 10 km in 30 min is 20.0 km/h.

streaks.title: How streaks work
tips: A value of 0 does not count: you have to actually do the habit.
The value has to meet the target: 2 hours of sleep with a target of 8 does not count.
Streaks follow your schedule. Work out Monday, Wednesday and Friday, hit all three, and that is a 3-day streak. Tuesday and Thursday do not break it.
